summary: Rows of the identity do not change the determinant: it is that of the upper left j × j block.

steps.claim: Unfold paddedLeading and leadingMinor and reindex the j × j block along the identification {a < j} ≃ Fin j.

The determinant of a matrix that agrees with the identity outside the rows {a < j} equals the determinant of its submatrix on {a < j} (det_piecewise_one_eq_submatrix_det); the remaining identifications are routine.
